leverage.exposure: A leveraged position is open and it is the single thing that can ruin the matchday: a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, whatever the eleven do. It is unwound by one instant sale and there is comfortable time to do it, so this is not yet urgent — but it is not optional either, and it should not be left to the last hours. No offer is live in either direction, so nothing can surprise the balance in the meantime.

binding_gap: The binding constraint is cash, not a formation hole. The squad can field a legal eleven right now and will still be able to after the sale, but only as a 4-4-2 exactly, with Nakuzola forced into the back four. After the sale the gap becomes a cheap defender better than Nakuzola — and nothing on the board fills it: the affordable defenders all score worse than he does, and the ones who score better cost more than the post-sale balance allows.

verdict.headline: Unchanged and still one move: sell Treu back to Kickbase to clear the deficit before the matchday locks.
verdict.headline_short: Unchanged and still one move: sell Treu back to Kickbase to clear the
verdict.detail: Unchanged and still one move: sell Treu back to Kickbase to clear the deficit before the matchday locks. The position has not moved a cent since the last run, but the market woke up — rivals spent a twenty-minute burst liquidating squad players back to Kickbase at market value, which is the same pre-lock leverage unwind Georg has to do. That is confirmation of the plan, not a reason to change it.

sell.reason: Treu remains the sale, and he remains the right one. He is the lowest-scoring of the regular back four on season average and also the most valuable, so he is the only single player whose instant sale clears the whole deficit on its own. Selling him back to Kickbase pays exactly market value with no spread and no auction risk. The cost is real and should be stated plainly: Nakuzola replaces him in the back four, which is a meaningful points drop for the matchday. There is no cheaper way to clear the deficit while keeping eleven bodies. Selling Deman instead does not clear it; selling both drops the squad to ten and triggers the penalty. Delaying the sale to catch tonight's market-value tick was already rejected and stays rejected: the gain is small and the downside is a zero-scoring matchday.

standing.name: Philipp Treu
standing.why: REPRICED AFTER THE 2026-10-07T20:00Z TICK. REPLACES Sqml4r1 (closed), whose 12.999.160 was the 06.10 mv. Treu's mv is now 13.059.228 (+60.068 on the tick; note sdmvt had signalled +180.290, so the realised tick was one third of the signal — record that, it bears on Wcb2whq's ~671k delay estimate, which is therefore an OVERestimate). SUBSTANCE UNCHANGED AND STILL BINDING: cash -12.028.040, and a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the whole of MD5. Instant sale to Kickbase pays exactly mv and takes the balance to +1.031.188 with exactly 11 players (1 GK / 4 DEF / 4 MID / 2 ATT = 4-4-2, legal). He is still the correct leg: of the five bodies individually large enough to clear a 12,03M deficit, Neuer (13.037.415) is the only GK so selling him leaves no legal formation; Engelhardt (14.777.914, ap 149), Nusa (28.219.003, ap 169) and Guirassy (32.917.300, ap 161) are all far better players; Treu at ap 76 is the cheapest in points terms. No two-body combination works either — the squad is 12, so a second sale drops it to 10 and triggers -100. Confirmed fit this run: st 0 on the live read AND absent from Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table (SC Freiburg's only entry there is Muslija, Kreuzbandriss). He is sold because he is the cheapest body that clears the deficit, not because of fitness. COST OF THE SALE, STATED PLAINLY: Nakuzola (ap 27) replaces him in the XI, so the sale costs roughly 49 points of expected average, and it leaves ZERO bench — see the companion BUY on Bachmann, which is the insurance against that.

buy.reason: One buy stands, and it is insurance rather than ambition: Bachmann off the Kickbase board at market value, as a twelfth body after the Treu sale. Without him the squad sits at exactly eleven with eleven placed and no bench at all, which leaves no room to react to late team news. He is a midfielder, so he does not fill the defensive hole the sale opens — that is a known limitation of the call, not an oversight. Nothing else on the board is worth buying. The three listings that arrived since the last run are all rejected: two are manager asks at large premiums on players carrying injury flags, the third is a falling-value board listing in a position Georg already covers and expiring after the lock.

standing.name: Janik Bachmann
standing.why: BENCH INSURANCE AGAINST THE -100 PENALTY. THIS IS A DIFFERENT QUESTION FROM AVOID A2wqgij AND DOES NOT REVERSE IT: that call rejected Bachmann for the TICK EDGE (mvt 0, measured drift +0,02%, correct and still correct). This buys him as a BODY, where mvt is irrelevant. THE EXPOSURE IT COVERS: the Treu sale leaves exactly 11 players and 11 placed, i.e. no bench at all, with MD5 team news still to land on 08-09.10. If any one of the eleven is ruled out between now and the 2026-10-09T18:30Z lock, Georg fields ten and takes -100 for the matchday. WHY BACHMANN SPECIFICALLY AND NOT A CHEAPER-LOOKING ALTERNATIVE: he must be an OUTFIELD body, because a GK bench body does not restore a legal formation — losing a DEF from 1/4/4/2 leaves 1/3/4/2, which is not a formation, and 3-4-3 needs three ATT and 3-5-2 needs five MID, neither of which the squad has. A MID body covers ALL THREE dropout cases: lose a MID and Bachmann restores 4-4-2; lose a DEF and it becomes 3-5-2; lose an ATT and it becomes 4-5-1. Of the 500.000 bodies on the board right now he is the only one that is simultaneously outfield, st 0, and priced at exactly mv with no u: Huebers (DEF 500.000) is st 1 with an 11-month knee injury on Ligainsider, Musah (ATT 500.000) is st 1 and Ligainsider says "monatelang ohne ihn", and Stergiou, Porath, Sakar, Ruben Mueller, Moussa Ndiaye and Uno are all JakobDohr manager asks at 600.000 against mv 500.000-506.271, i.e. above mv, which this ledger never pays. FINANCING: 1.031.188 - 500.000 = 531.188, still non-negative, so he requires NO unwind before the lock and carries no leverage. He is resellable to Kickbase at exactly mv at any time. BID EXACTLY 500.000 AND NEVER RAISE — at a 500.000 floor price any premium is pure loss on a body who is expected to score nothing. Expiry 2026-10-09T15:29Z is only ~3h before the lock, which is late but harmless: the balance is non-negative whether he wins or loses. ap 17, Schalke 04 (tid 8 — NOTE A CARRIED LEDGER ERROR: A2wqgij called him "MID SC Freiburg, tid 8"; tid 8 is SCHALKE 04, confirmed because Siebeking tid 8 appears under FC Schalke 04 on Ligainsider, while tid 5 is SC Freiburg).

killed_this_run.name: Kennet Eichhorn
killed_this_run.why: THE ONLY NEW LISTING SINCE THE 08:44Z RUN, logged so the "every new listing is swept" record stays unbroken. Eichhorn (11680, MID, tid 7) hit the Kickbase board at 2026-10-08T09:13:17Z (feed t=3, i 12981897397): no u, prc = mv = 1.317.626, mvt 1, exs 37827s so he resolves ~21:16Z tonight. KILLED TWICE OVER AND BOTH REASONS ARE DURABLE. (1) TIMING — he resolves ~76 minutes AFTER the 20:00:00Z tick, which is the last tick before the MD5 lock, so the tick edge cannot be captured at all; this is Wqi1195's two-clock test and it is the same reason Bornauw and Futkeu fail. (2) FITNESS — he is NOT available: his Kickbase listing carries st 1, and Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table read this run lists Kennet Eichhorn under Bayer Leverkusen as an absentee alongside Guela Doue and Montrell Culbreath. He also has no ap at all on the listing. So he fails as a flip on mechanics and as a points buy on availability, and there is no price at which he becomes either.

killed_this_run.name: Sebastiaan Bornauw
killed_this_run.why: THE MOST TEMPTING BUY ON THE BOARD THIS RUN, AND IT MUST BE REJECTED ON AFFORDABILITY, NOT ON QUALITY — logged so the next run does not re-derive it. He is genuinely attractive: DEF, Kickbase board listing at EXACTLY mv 8.225.828 (zero premium, so no premium-band question at all), mvt 1 (rising), st 0 fit, ap 38 — which is higher than Nakuzola's ap 27, and Nakuzola is FORCED into the XI by every single-sale unwind. So Bornauw would be the one buy that actually fixes the XI hole rather than papering over it. THE ARITHMETIC KILLS IT: cash is -12.028.040. The forced Treu sale (13.059.228) only reaches +1.031.188, against a price of 8.225.828. Financing him therefore requires selling a SECOND player, and every second sale available is a confirmed MD5 starter — and worse, dropping to 11 players puts Nakuzola straight back into the XI, which is the very thing Bornauw was bought to prevent. Modelled: sell Treu + buy Bornauw + sell Deman = 11 players, 4 DEF = ter Horst/Gruber/Nakuzola/Bornauw, Nakuzola starting again. Self-defeating. REVERSAL: a non-negative balance carrying at least 8,3M of genuine spare capacity (i.e. spare AFTER the unwind, not spending power against the 33% floor), with the squad still at 12+ bodies so no forced sale follows. Until then he is a right player at a wrong moment.

killed_this_run.name: AVOID the cheap-DEF-body alternatives to Bachmann — Koehn, Seol, Huebers all fail, and the arithmetic is stated once so no later run redoes it
killed_this_run.why: THE QUESTION THIS SETTLES: after the Treu sale the squad is 1 GK / 4 DEF / 4 MID / 2 ATT = 11, and the ONLY fillable formation is 4-4-2 exactly, with Nakuzola (ap 27, not in Mainz's probable XI) forced into the back four. That makes a cheap DEF body look more attractive than the MID Bachmann of B3fyppp, because a 5th DEF would restore 5-3-2 and 5-4-1. IT DOES NOT WORK, ON CASH: post-sale cash is exactly 1.031.188, so the only affordable extra body is a 500.000 listing. Koehn (3453) at 1.557.781 and Seol (13806) at 1.239.374 BOTH exceed it, and the resulting deficit would sit at the lock, which scores ZERO for the whole of MD5. The ledger rule that a negative balance is fine if it can be unwound (Hfbknqv) does NOT rescue them: unwinding means selling the body back before the lock, which defeats the entire purpose of buying a body to HOLD through the lock. Koehn is additionally mvt 2 (measured -3,22% on the tick) and ap 7; Seol expires 2026-10-09T18:01Z, twenty-nine minutes before the lock, which is an unacceptable settlement risk. THE ONLY 500.000 DEF ON THE BOARD IS HUEBERS (2069), and he is st 1 with an eleven-month knee absence per Ligainsider, so he could never be fielded — he would be a formation token only, and he expires 2026-10-08T07:28Z, inside three hours. BACHMANN THEREFORE STANDS AND B3fyppp IS CONFIRMED, NOT REVERSED: at 500.000 he is fit (not on either absence list), he is affordable (1.031.188 - 500.000 = +531.188 at the lock), and the formation argument against him is WEAKER THAN Wr1p5sq IMPLIED — with 1 GK / 4 DEF / 5 MID / 2 ATT he adds 4-5-1 and 3-5-2 as fillable formations alongside 4-4-2, where today only 4-4-2 would survive the sale. SEQUENCING IS BINDING: Bachmann settles 2026-10-09T15:29:46Z, three hours before the lock. If the Treu sale has NOT happened by then, that settlement takes the balance to -12.528.040 at the lock and scores ZERO. Sell first, bid second.

killed_this_run.name: SOURCE TRAP — flashscore.de's "5. Spieltag Verletzungen und Sperren" page is a 2023/24 article on a 2026 URL. Never cite it.
killed_this_run.why: LOGGED SO NO FUTURE RUN WASTES A WEB LEG ON IT, and because it would have produced a catastrophically wrong briefing if trusted. The URL flashscore.de/news/fu-ball-bundesliga-bundesliga-5-spieltag-verletzungen-und-sperren-in-der-ubersicht/CA5Jc9Ei/ renders with a 2026 footer and 2026 sidebar content and carries only an "Aktualisiert" label with NO timestamp, so it reads as current. It is not. Its own meta description says "der 5. Spieltag der Bundesliga 2023/24", and the player list proves it: Manuel Neuer with a lower-leg fracture (that is the 2023 injury; our Neuer is st 0, ap 143 and has played all four matchdays), Mateu Morey and Thomas Meunier at Dortmund, Daniel-Kofi Kyereh and Christian Günter at Freiburg. HOW IT WAS CAUGHT, as a reusable method alongside Wzkz5kj: cross-check the page's named absentees against live Kickbase st flags for players we actually hold. One contradiction on a squad player is enough to condemn the whole page — a genuinely current table never says our fit, four-times-fielded goalkeeper has a broken leg. THE GENERAL RULE THIS SHARPENS: an undated injury table is stale until proven otherwise, and a 2026 chrome around the article body proves nothing, because the chrome is templated and the body is not. The club-page route used instead this run (ligainsider SC Freiburg, which prints the fixture date 11.10.2026 and a lineup stamp of 21.09.2026) is the one to prefer, because it dates itself twice. The pid on this entry is Dahmen's only so the row has an anchor; it is NOT a judgement on Dahmen, whose own AVOID is A4vy4xi and rests on sizing.

Check all three legs before re-opening any closed AVOID.

Musah (11262, ATT Werder Bremen, tid 10) hit the Kickbase board at 2026-10-07T16:35:58Z, 10 minutes before this run. No u, prc = mv = 500.000, exs 169.253s (expires 2026-10-09T15:46Z). (4) At the 500.000 floor there is no capital at risk but also no capital at work: even a full +2,55% tick on 500.000 is 12.750, which is noise against a 12.028.040 deficit. Nothing here. The two board listings that DO carry mvt 1 — Dahmen (A4vy4xi, killed on size) and Bornauw (Apuc8fl, killed on timing) — remain the only live flip-shaped objects on the board and both remain correctly avoided; see this run's MOVERS note.

movers.reason: Closed again, and this time on arithmetic rather than sentiment. A flip only earns the drift if the listing resolves before a market-value update and that update lands before the lock. Only one update remains before the matchday locks, and not a single rising-value board listing expires before it. Eichhorn is the near miss — right flag, right price, but his auction runs out a little over an hour after the update, so he would be bought and never ticked. Futkeu and Seol fail the same way by a wider margin. No flip to recommend. Worth noting as a measured curiosity: a rival bought a board listing slightly below market value and sold it straight back seconds later for a tiny risk-free gain, which confirms board listings can clear under market value but is far too small to be a mechanism. The two open questions stand unchanged — it is still unknown whether Kickbase caps squad size, which would cap flip throughput, and the rising-flag edge is measured in one league over one period and will decay if rivals crowd in. Re-measured this run, it has not decayed.

fitness.sweep: Clean sweep, and better validated than usual. Ligainsider's injured-and-suspended table was read live this run and names none of Georg's twelve. None of them carries a Kickbase status flag either. As a cross-check, every board player who did carry a status flag turned up in the Ligainsider table with a matching injury, which means the status field is a reliable instrument and a cheap substitute for a per-player web leg when a run only needs a fit-or-not read.
